purpose: Pinned unmodified Midea/Coolix/Bosch144 protocol sources, test vectors, send/checksum helpers, and license used to verify the portable adaptation. These reference sources are not linked into firmware.

candidate_c_evidence.capture_author_claim: Logic analyser capture of RN02S13 controlling Midea Lengjingxing AC; this is not a confirmed capture of RN10L2(B2HS)/BG.
candidate_c_evidence.source_not_vendored_reason: No LICENSE provided. Only research links and reconstructed protocol facts retained; implementation ported from licensed IRremoteESP8266 Bosch144.
candidate_c_evidence.known_boundaries: Exact RN10L2(B2HS)/BG mapping and device-specific optical waveform unconfirmed. Candidate C requires physical appliance test.

actual_capture_author_source_check.method: Compiled original fixed-commit RN02S13 .cpp/.h in auto-cleaned temporary directory with mock IRsend::sendData, ASan/UBSan. Called setModes(1), setFanSpeeds(0), cleared prior output, setTemps(26), then setPowers(0).
actual_capture_author_source_check.result: Both ON 3-section and OFF 2-section transmitted bytes exactly match derived vectors. GPIO/optical transmission and actual AC response were not tested.

settings.setter_order: stateReset -> setTemp -> setMode -> setFan -> setPower -> send(default repeat=1)

full_coolix_control.special_case: Fan-only uses native Dry mode with temperature code 0xE. Temperature must be set BEFORE mode. Auto fan in Auto/Dry maps to native Auto0=0; explicit manual speeds are accepted by upstream setters.
unimplemented_boundaries: Timer messages require separate Coolix48 support; no timer setter in IRCoolixAC
ECO has no official Coolix setting in IRac
Separate horizontal swing has no IRCoolixAC setter
full_coolix_control.legacy_candidates: Midea48/Bosch144 retain previous Cool+Auto payloads only; non-default mode/fan is explicitly rejected.
full_coolix_control.upstream_comment_issue: kCoolixSwingH actual binary constant is B2F5A2, but its hex comment says B5F5A2. Turbo actual constant is B5F5A2; this is a misleading comment, not an actual constant collision.
full_coolix_control.physical_boundary: User has verified the baseline Coolix24 26C cool/auto control. Newly added modes, fan speeds and actions remain subject to physical appliance acceptance; native waveform comparison is not physical verification.
